display_name.description: Human-readable name for lang/en/{component}.php (default: derived from name)

features.description: Comma-separated stub files to scaffold: database, tasks, services, events, capabilities, settings

maturity.description: $plugin->maturity constant: MATURITY_ALPHA (default), MATURITY_BETA, MATURITY_RC, or MATURITY_STABLE

name.description: Plugin name, lowercase letters/digits/underscores only, must start with a letter

requires.description: $plugin->requires value (default: the configured Moodle installation's build number)

type.description: Plugin type (local, mod, block, auth, tool, enrol, theme, report, format, filter, qtype, ...)
